title: FrontDesk AI stored tickets
description: The value of localStorage key frontdesk.tickets: a JSON array with one ticket for every message a patient sends, whatever its status. chat.js builds the ticket and addTicket() in core.js adds id, created and staffReplies. replyToTicket() and setStatus() change status and set updated. tickets() returns [] when the key is missing, unreadable or not an array. Nothing deletes a ticket.

id.description: "T" + Date.now() in base 36, upper case, + two random base-36 characters, upper case.

patient.description: The patient session id from frontdesk.patient: "P" + random base-36 characters, upper case (normally five). The chat shows only the tickets whose patient is this browser's id.

reply.description: The reply shown: the model's text when it passed guard(), otherwise the rules engine's text.

source.description: model when the model's wording was used; file when the rules engine's own text was used (labelled "Answered from the clinic file").

lang.description: Worked out from the script of the message (Telugu, Devanagari, else English), not from the language menu.

bookingTime.description: For a booking: the day and time read from the message (for example "tomorrow 5:00 pm"), or "not given". Empty string for every other kind.

afterHours.description: true when openNow() said the clinic was closed at the moment the ticket was made.

afterHoursNote.description: The closed-now note in the reply's language, naming the next opening when one is found; empty string when afterHours is false.

callBack.description: true when the status given by the rules engine was needs human. Not changed later.

updated.description: Milliseconds since 1970. Absent until the first staff reply or Close ticket.

staffReplies.description: Replies sent from the staff page, oldest first. Starts empty.
